title: Dolan finds Timothy Good's Above Top Secret in a Syracuse bookstore

tellings.quote: I was in a bookstore, just like a ordinary bookstore, one day in Syracuse, New York, and I saw a copy of Timothy Good's very classic work, Above Top Secret.

plain: A researcher and writer on UFOs, Richard Dolan, says that one day in 1994 he walked into an ordinary bookstore in Syracuse, New York. There he spotted Above Top Secret, a book by the British writer Timothy Good about governments keeping UFO information secret, which Dolan calls a classic. He tells it as the moment his own long interest in the subject began.
